title: Locksmith Follow-Up Visit Checklist Form
subtitle: Control authority verification, access service, key control, testing, and secure release through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete locksmith service follow-up visit checklist for openings, locks, keys, credentials, closers, and access devices. It connects verified access authority and approved security scope to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a qualified locksmith must compare a current locksmith service condition with prior service evidence, decide whether it is planned, recurring, incomplete, or new, and assign the next action.

sections.title: Locksmith follow-up visit checklist closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This locksmith service follow-up visit checklist is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when identity, access authority, property scope, key control, alarm integration, fire egress, security function, or credential custody is uncertain. A locksmith, security, or egress supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
